lead.zh-Hans: 衣角翘起来以后，我被问会不会飞。
lead.en: A lifted coat corner earned me a question about flying.

text.zh-Hans: 到了克鲁斯洛马的休息区，我把外套搭在肩上，坐下让脚歇一会儿。衣角被手肘带得翘起来，旁边的小朋友问我是不是准备飞走。我把手收回，衣角落下去，他竟有点失望。我答应走之前给他看个稳当的收翅膀办法，可低头找系带时，先摸到了邮包上多余的那一截。
text.en: At a rest area in Cruz Loma, I draped my coat over my shoulders and sat down. My elbow lifted a corner, and a child asked whether I was about to fly away. I lowered my arm; he looked rather disappointed. I promised to demonstrate a reliable way of folding my wings before leaving. Searching for the coat ties, I first found the loose end of my mailbag strap.
Show him the coat with both sides tied
Tell the coat ties from the bag strap

lead.zh-Hans: 两只手套同一双，颜色却对不上。
lead.en: A matching pair of gloves refused to match.

text.zh-Hans: 兰花园里，一位旅人把手套举在身前，想比较它和花朵的颜色。我停在步道上等他看完，他却把另一只手套递给我，请我站远一点。我们没有靠近花，只隔着空处举着各自那只手套。等他点头，我把手套还回去，他忽然笑了，原来我举的那只是里面朝外，比另一只浅得多。
text.en: In the orchid gardens, a visitor held up a glove to compare its colour with a flower. I waited on the path while he handed me its partner and asked me to stand a little farther away. We compared them without moving closer to the plants. When I returned mine, he laughed: I had held it inside out, making it much paler than the other glove.
Ask which side of the glove to compare
Check whether the glove is inside out

lead.zh-Hans: 面皮先落下去，奶酪还得再找一口。
lead.en: The pastry settled before the cheese came into reach.

text.zh-Hans: 土豆浓汤吃好后，我拿起刚做好的奶酪炸馅饼，想从鼓鼓的中间咬一口。面皮先轻轻塌下来，奶酪还在远一点的地方。我换个角度再咬，终于碰到馅，脸上也沾了一点糖。对面的旅人正要说话，我先举手按住嘴边，等咽完再开口，他笑着指了指我的另一边脸颊。
text.en: After my locro, I bit into the puffed centre of an empanada de viento. The pastry settled before I reached the cheese. A second bite from another angle found it and left sugar on my cheek. My companion began to speak, but I raised a hand to wipe my mouth first. Once I had swallowed, he smiled and pointed to my other cheek.
Ask whether the other cheek has sugar too
Look at the little patch of settled pastry

lead.zh-Hans: 另一只手忙了半天，其实没碰到碗。
lead.en: My free hand worked hard without touching anything.

text.zh-Hans: 我把奶酪炸馅饼留在一旁，先喝土豆浓汤。牛油果片浮在勺子前头，我每次轻轻往下舀，它都跟着退一点。我放下勺子，端正坐好，才从碗边慢慢绕过去，连汤带那一片一起舀起。吃到嘴里才发现，刚才一直绷着的另一只手，还悬在半空替勺子保持平衡，根本没碰到碗。
text.en: I left my empanada aside and began the locro. An avocado slice drifted away whenever I lowered my spoon. I sat upright and approached gently from the edge, finally lifting both soup and avocado together. Only after eating it did I notice my other hand hovering in the air. It had been balancing the expedition without ever touching the bowl.
Describe my unnecessary balancing hand
See which side let the avocado aboard

lead.zh-Hans: 杯盖拧开了，他却又认真盖了回去。
lead.en: He carefully replaced the lid he had just removed.

text.zh-Hans: 邻座的小朋友一手拿奶酪炸馅饼，一手想拧水杯，怎么也腾不出空。我先把自己的土豆浓汤放稳，问他要不要我扶住杯身。他点头，轻轻把杯盖拧开，又很认真地盖回去。我以为他不想喝了，他却说先放下点心才好端杯。我收回手，看着他把两件事分开做完，再低头喝自己的汤。
text.en: A child beside me held an empanada while trying to unscrew his water cup. I settled my locro and asked whether I could steady the cup. He nodded, removed the lid, and carefully replaced it. I wondered if he had changed his mind about drinking. He explained that he needed to put down his pastry first. I watched him finish the two separate jobs, then returned to my soup.
Ask whether I should steady the cup

text.zh-Hans: 看放下点心后怎样喝水
text.en: Watch him lift the cup after setting down his pastry

lead.zh-Hans: 花没动，排队给它看的我们先动了。
lead.en: The flowers outlasted their restless little audience.

text.zh-Hans: 兰花园的步道上，一个小朋友忽然停住，伸着双手一动不动。他的家人问怎么了，他小声说想让花看清自己。我也停下，免得挡住他。过了一会儿，他先忍不住揉了揉鼻子，随后家人打了个哈欠。我把嘴闭紧，偏偏肚子响了一声，大家才一起慢慢往前走，孩子那双手终于也放了下来。
text.en: A child stopped on the orchid garden path and held his hands out, perfectly still. Asked why, he whispered that he wanted the flowers to get a good look at him. I paused to avoid blocking their view. He eventually rubbed his nose; a family member yawned. I kept my mouth shut, only for my stomach to growl. We moved along together, and the child finally lowered his hands.
Tell who moved first
Notice how we stayed on the path

lead.zh-Hans: 你说“{reply}”，我先找对了真正的衣带。
lead.en: You wrote, “{reply}.” I found the actual coat ties first.

text.zh-Hans: 我找准外套的系带，把两边衣角收好，再走到那个问我会不会飞的小朋友面前。他绕着我看了半圈，点头说现在可以走路了。我认真迈出一步，外套没有再翘起，邮包却轻轻碰到腿侧。我把包带提好，等他也站回家人身边，我们才从休息区各自往前走，衣角一直好好垂着。
text.en: I found the coat ties and secured both corners before showing the child who had asked about flying. He inspected half a circle around me and declared me ready for walking. My first careful step left the coat in place, though the mailbag bumped my leg. I shortened its strap and waited for him to rejoin his family. We left the rest area with my coat hanging neatly down.
Say goodbye to my young inspector
Check that the coat corners stay down

lead.zh-Hans: 抱起邮包以后，花重新露了出来。
lead.en: Lifting my mailbag restored someone else’s view.

text.zh-Hans: 我认得基多植物园兰花园里的那种温暖气息，重来时便放慢脚步。一位旅人蹲在步道上看花，我从后面绕过去，发现自己的邮包正好遮住他的视线。我没有催他起身，只把包抱到胸前，侧着走完那一小段。他抬头朝我点点头，我也回头点了一下，转回来时才看见自己已经走到同伴后面，正好不用再让路。
text.en: The warmth of the orchid gardens was familiar when I returned to Quito Botanical Garden. A visitor crouched on the path to look at a flower. Passing behind him, I noticed that my mailbag blocked his view. I held it against my chest and moved sideways through the narrow space. He looked up and nodded; I nodded back. Facing forward again, I found myself behind my companion, with no further passing manoeuvre required.
Nod goodbye to the visitor
Check whether the bag blocks the view
